description:
30th October – Seventh Charter Night – Rotaract Club of Bombay Mid-Town
It was a delight for Rtn PP Abuzar Zakir to join the celebrations at the 7th Charter Nite of the Rotaract Club of Bombay Mid-Town hosted at the IGTC College Auditorium, Chowpatty on Thursday, 30th October 2026
The evening featured a vibrant awards presentation, insightful member showcases and the formal announcement of the incoming President for 2026–27, Rtr. Krisha Shah
An exceptional gathering defined by youthful enthusiasm, camaraderie and remarkable energy.
Attended by 55 Rotaractors and 1 Rotarian
